us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: House Republicans block effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth
bullets: House Republicans moved to derail the impeachment push against Hegseth.
Democrats accused Hegseth of abusing power and undermining national security.
The issue could return after Democrats take House control in January.

articles.title: Trump says Iran war is militarily ‘effectively over’ after meeting Qatari prime minister
bullets: Trump said he is not prepared to resume bombardment of Iran for now.
He said Iran is talking to the U.S. ‘very politely.’
The conflict has rattled global energy markets and U.S. politics.

articles.title: Appeals court rules Trump administration illegally fired Voice of America chief
bullets: A federal appeals court unanimously ruled against the firing.
The case concerns leadership of the U.S.-funded international broadcaster.
The ruling was highlighted in a national legal-news roundup.

articles.title: U.S. faces review over possible loss of measles-elimination status
bullets: PAHO experts are set to review whether the U.S. remains measles-free.
The U.S. earned measles-elimination status in 2000.
HHS said its outbreak response would not fundamentally change.

articles.title: Kennedy family members sue to block Trump memorial arch near Arlington gravesites
bullets: Nine Kennedy family members asked a judge to stop the project.
They say the arch would affect views near Kennedy gravesites.
The proposed structure is reported as 250 feet tall.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Russia and Ukraine hold nearly four hours of U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi
bullets: The first day of talks ended in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday.
Washington called for a new security framework.
European leaders voiced concern about any deal excluding Europe.

articles.title: Drone attack causes fire at Russia’s Baltic Sea port of Ust-Luga
bullets: A drone attack sparked a fire at the Baltic Sea port.
The incident was reported by the regional governor.
Ust-Luga is a key Russian port facility.

articles.title: Italy evacuates more than 300 schools after bomb threats
bullets: Italian authorities evacuated hundreds of schools Wednesday.
The emailed threats also referenced Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni.
Similar disruptions have recently hit European institutions.

articles.title: Deadly blast hits major Turkish steel producer
bullets: A blast at a Turkish steel producer killed workers.
Another dozen people were injured, one critically.
The incident was reported in international coverage Wednesday.

articles.title: DR Congo reports Ebola outbreak concerns in global headlines
bullets: A DR Congo Ebola outbreak appeared in NPR’s latest headline roundup.
The item was listed among major overnight global stories.
Details were carried in the November 11 NPR News Now summary.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: India holds Pernod and Diageo Scotch shipments amid tariff investigation
bullets: Indian customs is holding bulk Scotch containers from Pernod and Diageo.
Investigators are seeking a higher tariff assessment.
Reuters reported the story from New Delhi on November 11.

articles.title: Mother Dairy to raise milk prices by ₹2–4 per litre from November 12
bullets: The price increase applies from Thursday, November 12.
Hindustan Times reported the hike on November 11.
The change affects Mother Dairy milk consumers in India.

articles.title: Karnataka chief minister says ethanol blending has hurt vehicle mileage
bullets: The claim appeared in Indian Express live updates Wednesday.
The issue concerns fuel blending and vehicle efficiency.
Ethanol blending remains a national fuel-policy topic in India.

articles.title: IIT Madras opens GATE 2027 application correction window until November 14
bullets: IIT Madras is organising the 2027 GATE exam.
The correction window is open until November 14.
NDTV listed the update in its November 11 latest-news feed.

articles.title: Vessel carrying six Indians hit in Persian Gulf, Hindustan Times reports
bullets: The incident involved a vessel carrying six Indians.
It was listed in Hindustan Times’ November 11 morning brief.
The item appeared alongside major national and global headlines.

articles.title: CoreWeave jumps after revenue beat and stronger 2026 outlook
bullets: CoreWeave rose more than 15% before Wednesday’s open.
The AI cloud company posted better-than-expected third-quarter revenue.
It also raised its 2026 revenue outlook.

articles.title: Nvidia shares stabilize after brutal week tied to Huang controversy
bullets: Nvidia shares stabilized in premarket trading Wednesday.
The stock had suffered two days of steep losses.
The controversy involves CEO Jensen Huang and alleged espionage concerns.

articles.title: U.S. stock futures climb as AI trade rebounds
bullets: U.S. futures rose Wednesday before the market open.
Nasdaq-100 futures led gains, helped by AI-linked stocks.
The move followed Tuesday’s inflation-driven selloff.

articles.title: Major U.S. indexes fell Tuesday after hotter inflation report
bullets: U.S. stocks declined after inflation exceeded economist expectations.
Treasury yields jumped in Tuesday’s bond-market trading.
Oil prices continued to ease during the session.

articles.title: Veterans Day trading proceeds for stocks while bond market closes
bullets: U.S. stock markets are open Wednesday, November 11.
Veterans Day is a bank and bond-market holiday.
The bond closure may reduce rate-market signals for traders.

articles.title: Hapag-Lloyd raises outlook again on strong freight rates
bullets: Hapag-Lloyd raised its full-year earnings outlook Wednesday.
It was the company’s third outlook increase.
Reuters linked the move to strong freight rates.

articles.title: Deutsche Bank launches digital-asset custody service
bullets: Deutsche Bank announced the custody launch Wednesday.
The service targets digital assets for clients.
The launch was reported by Reuters from Frankfurt.

articles.title: UK regulator gives AkzoNobel and Axalta one week to address merger concerns
bullets: The companies are pursuing a $25 billion merger.
The UK regulator said competition concerns remain.
They have one week to offer remedies.

articles.title: RWE and KKR finalize $16 billion UK renewables investment
bullets: RWE and KKR finalized the UK renewables deal Wednesday.
The investment is valued at $16 billion.
Reuters reported the transaction in business coverage.

articles.title: ITV warns fourth-quarter advertising revenue may fall up to 10%
bullets: ITV issued the advertising warning Wednesday.
The broadcaster expects fourth-quarter ad revenue pressure.
The update follows ITV’s agreement to sell channels and streaming operations.

articles.title: Nvidia CEO controversy raises Washington concerns over AI-chip security
bullets: Jensen Huang’s alleged affair has triggered political scrutiny.
Officials worry about possible access to sensitive AI-chip technology.
The controversy comes amid U.S.-China AI competition.

articles.title: Alleged spy plot targeting Jensen Huang raises questions about Nvidia’s future
bullets: Investigations focus on whether Huang was targeted by foreign intelligence.
A shareholder complaint says Nvidia misled investors about risks.
Nvidia remains central to the global AI boom.

articles.title: Military-linked Chinese university bought Nvidia H200 chips despite U.S. blacklist
bullets: Reuters reviewed records showing H200 chip purchases.
The buyer was a Chinese university tied to the military.
The chips were reportedly bought through Shaanxi Bosuan Network Technology.

articles.title: France AI council urges stronger safeguards for AI assistants
bullets: France’s AI and digital-technology council submitted a report November 10.
The report urged protections against assistants exploiting user vulnerabilities.
The item was listed in November 11 AI news coverage.

articles.title: Finland clears Tesla assisted-driving technology after changes
bullets: Finland granted provisional approval Wednesday.
Tesla made changes before receiving clearance.
Reuters reported the decision from Stockholm.
